llama_cpp.clone: full history (non-shallow), so binaries report build 10453; a shallow clone reports build 1

cpu.note: GGML_NATIVE=ON tunes for this host CPU; not a redistributable runtime (release bundles use upstream prebuilts).

cuda.version: 0.1.0-dev (build 10453, commit 3cb7ffb1a), built with GNU 16.2.1 for Linux x86_64

vulkan.reason: No Vulkan headers (/usr/include/vulkan) and no glslc on this host; system packages were not installed. build_llama_cpp.sh vulkan builds it once vulkan-headers and shaderc are present.

converter.requirements: src/requirements/requirements-convert_hf_to_gguf.txt (torch 2.11.0+cpu, numpy 1.26.4, sentencepiece 0.2.2, protobuf 4.25.9, gguf-py from the source tree)
converter.deviation: transformers 5.5.0 instead of the pinned 4.57.6. The checkpoint was saved by transformers 5.5.0 with tokenizer_class 'TokenizersBackend', and 4.57.6 fails with 'Tokenizer class TokenizersBackend does not exist'. The campaign's earlier b10453 conversions also ran under transformers 5.5.0 (.venv-sft). tokenizers 0.22.2.

changes: --outtype bf16 by default (f16 optional); the bf16 GGUF is the quantization source and reference
tiers Q8_0, Q6_K, Q5_K_M, Q4_K_M, IQ4_XS; Q4_K_M needs --imatrix or --uncalibrated; any IQ tier or override needs --imatrix
pass-through: --imatrix, repeated --tensor-type PATTERN=TYPE, --output-tensor-type, --token-embedding-type (any ggml type at the pin, case-insensitive) and --dry-run

receipts record every input and output path, size and sha256 (HF converter inputs, source GGUF, imatrix, quantizer binary, output), the converter commit and command, quantizer build and command, every flag, and wall times
SEPALITH_LLAMA_CPP locates the pinned install; LLAMA_QUANT, LLAMA_CONVERT and LLAMA_CONVERT_PYTHON override single pieces
unchanged: the --no-nextn arch gate for qwen architectures, the converter pin check, NO_LORA and MERGE_VIA_PEFT modes, imatrix provenance check

tests.result: 11 passed (6 new: bf16 default plus arch gate, source cleanup, quantizer flag pass-through plus receipts, invalid combinations, dry run, converter pin)

smoke.model: CPT parent checkpoint 11586 (LlamaForCausalLM, 42 layers, hidden 2048, 16/2 heads, vocab 130,560, untied embeddings). This is the parent CPT model, not a product; quality was not evaluated and nothing was uploaded.
smoke.command: NO_LORA=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="" nice -n 10 python3 experiments/training/export_gguf.py unused <hf_dir> parent-11586 --out-dir <out_dir> --keep-source --tiers Q8_0 Q4_K_M --uncalibrated --threads 8
smoke.host_contention: Load average 24 to 28 on 24 logical CPUs from other jobs (nice 5 Python workers) during the run. Timings are wall-clock on a contended box; they are not latency measurements.

metadata.eog_note: The GGUF stores eos 1; llama.cpp auto-detects '<|im_end|>' (130073) as EOT, so both end-of-generation ids from config.json stop generation.
converter_warnings: Unknown RoPE type: default (rope scaling NONE, theta 5e6 written correctly)

Q4_K_M.note: token_embd and output stay q8_0 (270.94 MiB each, about a third of the file); no imatrix exists for this model yet

generation.prompt: smoke-prompt.R: a toy roxygen-documented rescale01() stub written for this smoke, not from TRAIN, DEV or final data
generation.verdict: All three files load on CPU and produce syntactically plausible R. Speeds reflect the contended host and the drvfs (/mnt/e) location, not the model.
generation.logs: smoke.sh, smoke-<tier>.out, smoke-<tier>.log, smoke-summary.txt and export.log in out_dir

open_for_c09: No imatrix for the Sepalith model yet; IQ4_XS needs one and a calibrated Q4_K_M arm wants one. Build it from TRAIN-side text only, keeping DEV and final rows out.
The DEV75 llama.cpp parity check (Q8_0 within 2 of bf16) needs a campaign_eval-compatible llama.cpp path and a quiet CPU or the GPU window; CPU throughput on this box is too contended for timings.

Scripts that still hardcode experiments/bin/llama/llama-b10453/ (eval_scenarios.py, eval_noop_fp.py, spec_bench.py, harness_search, scripts/packaging/*.sh) need a symlink to build-cpu/bin in their checkout, or SEPALITH_LLAMA_CPP support.
No Vulkan build here (missing vulkan-headers and shaderc); the C17 notebook latency check needs one on the notebook.
